root_cause: A changed connector records a CSRD/privacy/finance impact assessment, but activation previously checked only connector test/plan data. Browser clients could also submit state=Active or untrusted runtime approval metadata in draft writes.
prevention: Re-use the existing tenant connector review queue for pending cross-domain events, with safe human-readable domain and ESRS candidates.
Reject activation before provider execution while any applicable latest change impact is pending.
Server forces drafts to Draft state and ignores browser-supplied authorization/review objects.
Increment connector configuration version on real changes to invalidate stale test proof; distinguish operational readbacks from configuration changes.

evidence.outcome: Fail-closed review gate and safe review-queue projection in connector API. Does not prove any reviewed connector is activated; approvals must use authoritative evidence.
